counts.joints_detail: 1071 copper pads on fitted parts: 1044 SMD pads + 27 plated-hole pads (6 THT connector pins J2/J3/J4, 4 USB-C J1 shield legs, 17 thermal-via pads inside the U100 and U4 exposed-pad footprints); 1020 distinct pad numbers
counts.source: kicad-cli sch export bom + kicad-cli pcb export pos + pcbnew Python read of a scratch copy of linknode.kicad_pcb (2026-11-23)

pcb.spec: FR-4 TG150, 4 layers, 78 x 62 mm, 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, 4/4 mil class, 0.2 mm min hole, green/white, tented vias, single pieces, standard build time
pcb.source: PCBWay instant-quote calculator, https://www.pcbway.com/orderonline.aspx (its backend https://www.pcbway.com/Quote/GetDeliveryDays/ queried with the form values above, 2026-11-23; raw replies in web/pcbway_pcb_quotes.json). Checked that the parameters are honoured: 2 layers = $19.22, 3/3 mil = $300.95, 0.15 mm via = $361.80 at qty 10.

assembly.inputs: Turnkey, single pieces, both sides, 89 unique parts, 298 SMD parts, 7 BGA/QFP-class parts (ICs > 16 pins, irregular parts > 10 pins), 3 THT parts
assembly.fee_basis: PCBWay quote form asks for counts of unique parts, SMD parts, BGA/QFP parts and through-hole parts (per part, not per joint); https://www.pcbway.com/quotesmt.aspx

stencil.note: Stencil adds $15 when ordered (370 x 470 mm framework, queried); PCBWay states "PCBA provides free stencil" (https://www.pcbway.com/pcb-assembly.html) and the assembly quote shows no stencil line, so $0 is used. Budget $15-30 if they charge for top and bottom stencils.

promo_29.why: $29 offer is limited to max 200 components per board (this board has 301) and 20 boards; https://www.pcbway.com/blog/PCB_Design_Layout/How_to_Get_29_PCB_Assembly_and_Meet_the_Requirements_e334dbde.html

assembly.component_sourcing_markup: Not published. The SMT quote states "Price does not include PCB fabrication or the cost of components" (https://www.pcbway.com/quotesmt.aspx); parts are priced after BOM review. Industry markups 25-100%+ (Altium, https://resources.altium.com/p/what-every-pcb-buyer-should-know-about-buying-assemblies) are not PCBWay figures.
assembly.excluded: Customs duties and VAT not included (quotesmt.aspx notice). Shipping not published as a fixed rate: omitted.
assembly.source: PCBWay SMT instant-quote calculator https://www.pcbway.com/quotesmt.aspx (backend /Quote/GetDeliveryDays/, 2026-11-23; raw replies in web/pcbway_smt_quotes.json, web/pcbway_smt_sensitivity.json)

totals.note: Components at LCSC price (no PCBWay markup, none published). ENIG is the headline because of the 0.35 mm-pitch QFN-128 (judgement, not a PCBWay requirement); HASL shown for comparison. Excludes shipping, duties/VAT, the PCBWay sourcing markup, the stencil, and the off-board items.

unverified: RV1106G3 price: live LCSC $23.867 (1+) / $21.1402 (30+), JLCPCB $23.6465 / $20.9449 (30+), stock 428 (LCSC) / 613 (JLCPCB). A web-search snippet of an older LCSC/JLCPCB index showed about $7.78 (1) / $5.33 (100+); that page could not be re-checked, so the current $21-24 is used. No published 100+ tier; Rockchip/agent pricing for volume is unknown. The G2 (C5272606) is $13.68 (1) / $10.90 (100).
HT-HC01 V2 price $11.90 is the Heltec store single-unit price (https://heltec.org/project/ht-hc01); no volume tiers, no shipping; not stocked by LCSC, so PCBWay turnkey cannot source it from LCSC.
PCBWay component sourcing markup or handling fee: not published; final PCBA price is set after BOM review.

PCBWay instant quotes are estimates read from their calculator backend on 2026-11-23 (no account, default shipping country); PCBWay says the final price is subject to review. Confirm at https://www.pcbway.com/orderonline.aspx and https://www.pcbway.com/pcb-assembly.html.
Stencil: assumed free with PCBA (PCBWay statement); $15 per stencil if charged.
Shipping, customs duties and VAT: not published as fixed figures, not included.

PCB spec assumptions: 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner copper, TG150, no impedance control, no via-in-pad/resin fill. If the RV1106 EP thermal vias or USB/RF lines need via-in-pad or impedance control, the PCB price rises (impedance control: $135.37 ENIG at qty 10, $244.47 at qty 100).
J1 USB-C has 4 plated shield legs; counted as an SMD part (PCBWay may count it as THT: +$2.3 to +$4.6 per order in the sensitivity runs).
Four basic passives (C19666, C19702, C307331, C23733) show LCSC stock 0 on 2026-11-23 but are in stock at JLCPCB; prices use the LCSC ladder.
Attrition/spares (extra reels or loss parts a CM adds for 0402s) not included.
Placement and joint counts come from the board as of 2026-11-23 while routing is in progress; parts may still change.
